outlook.statement: The long-term outlook for the Indian paper industry remains positive, supported by economic growth, increasing literacy, demand from institutional sectors, and the transition towards sustainable packaging solutions. The Company is well positioned to leverage its experience in agro-based paper manufacturing and continues to focus on strengthening operational efficiency, maintaining product quality, and creating sustainable value for its stakeholders.

The paper industry has been recovering well from local issues and global uncertainties. Rapid urbanization, increase in disposable income, increase in literacy level, e-commerce trends and sustainable growth trends augur well for the Indian paper industry. Implementation of National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 along with other measures by Indian Government in field of education & literacy should lend considerable boost to the demand for writing and printing paper. The policy thrust by the Government of India & States for reducing/eliminating the use of single use plastic is going to support sustainable products such as paper. Domestic market opportunities are quite promising and healthy. The Government needs to remove anomalies in GST on paper and curb dumping of paper by certain countries under the cover of FTAs. The cost of manufacturing in India is quite competitive as compared to China which can help India gain and corner major chunk of global demand with the support of export oriented policies.
